entry.title: Welcome to my research blog
entry.content:
Welcome to my personal research website! I’m Anton Pushkin, an independent researcher working on cosmology and fast radio bursts.

In this blog, I’ll share updates on my research, thoughts on methodology, and insights from working with astronomical data. Stay tuned for posts about:

  • The FwCC pipeline and its development
  • Thoughts on FRB cosmology and future prospects
  • Technical tutorials on Bayesian inference and computational methods

Feel free to explore my research, publications, and code. If you’re interested in collaboration, don’t hesitate to reach out!
entry.summary: Introduction to my research and future plans
